about: Security: rules from client config files run through Function(). Replace it with a safe evaluator; graded by values, precedence, and rules that try to run code.

engagement.title: Tally: discount rules can run code

goals.title: Client rules are data, never code
goals.objective: A discount rule from a client's file can compute a number and nothing else.

todos.text: src/rules.js runs discount rules from client config files through Function(), so a rule can run any code. Replace it with an evaluator that allows only numbers, variable names, + - * / and parentheses (with the usual precedence and unary minus), and throws on anything else. Add tests, including rules that try to run code.
